visualReview.notes: Inspected the original terrain overview, four turntables and near views of the octagonal gallery, lengthy sidings and open display canopies, the round turntable with its traversing bridge and the Rail Cafeteria. The fixed rail yard follows the mapped runs at the original local elevation.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected nine dated geographic placement images and confirmed bounded placement and unload. The viewer’s flat test plane was lowered to Y=-5.12 so it displays the complete below-origin track fan and turntable. This fixture verifies the transform and shared materials; original terrain placement was inspected separately.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 25 current runtime frames. The four detail levels retain the mapped site silhouette and track network. Close images show curved canopy sections, steel ribs, gravel beds, individual railheads, ties and turntable guard rails. Some subdivision of the far track ribbons follows the resolution of the terrain and simplified profiles.

geographicReview.notes: Verified the named museum and its six mapped footprints, the fifteen mapped rail alignments including the turntable ring and the named turntable point. Visually inspected the unmasked original Terrarium field. Local foundation height, rail grade and canopy placement remain estimates.

fidelityReview.scope: National Rail Museum at Chanakyapuri in its October 2023 appearance, including the octagonal Indoor Gallery, fixed outdoor tracks and turntable, open-sided rolling-stock display canopies, Rail Cafeteria and mapped service buildings.
fidelityReview.notes: Five exact 2023 Qualla photos establish curved corrugated roofing, openings between steel posts, bent braces, brick platform strips and ballast. Written sources establish the outdoor railway yard and turntable. The octagonal Indoor Gallery and cafeteria follow the mapped envelopes. Their smaller exterior details, canopy extents and turntable bridge are approximated.

imageryReview.notes: Five exact Qualla originals from the photographer Historical Trains were verified against their native uploads and creator’s CC0 dedications. Attribution-share-alike entrance and shed pictures were excluded. No photographs are baked into the model.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: National Rail Museum at Chanakyapuri, including its Indoor Gallery, associated mapped buildings and the fixed outdoor yard, canopies, railway and turntable in October 2023.

limitations: The Indoor Gallery, Rail Cafeteria and fixed yard buildings follow the mapped footprints. Their external finishes, roof sections and door positions are approximate.
Open-sided steel canopies follow the October 2023 Qualla originals. Individual canopy dimensions, their exact extents along the chosen four sidings, and the turntable bridge are estimates.

The original elevation field controls the terrain and track grade. India’s common 1.676 m broad gauge and a two-foot visitor-track gauge are approximations for the museum alignments. The track bend radii and turnout hardware are generalized.
The structures represent the preserved railway yard in 2023. Rolling stock, station exhibits, gardens and interiors are outside this model.
